players.product: Optical thin-film deposition equipment for data-center optical transceivers: vapor deposition (OTFC-1300 / SPOC-1300) for AR/HR and WDM/TFF filter films on lasers, optical filters and modules; sputtering (OWLS-1800 / SPOC-S-1200) for SiPh PIC, TFLN and optical-engine films; ALD and etching systems

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 FY12/2026 orders received rose 80% YoY (up 7% QoQ) to JPY 15.9bn, driven by the optical communications segment, exceeding internal targets by more than JPY 5.0bn - the eighth consecutive quarter of QoQ order growth. Order backlog rose 84% YoY to JPY 48.0bn (up 21% QoQ), approaching the all-time high of JPY 49.2bn recorded in 3Q FY12/2022; contract liabilities reached a record JPY 24.5bn at the end of 2Q.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 orders JPY 15.9bn (+80% YoY); backlog JPY 48.0bn (+84% YoY); contract liabilities JPY 24.5bn

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 FY12/2026 order mix: optical components orders rose 249% YoY to JPY 9.7bn on growth in optical communications; orders for optical communications-related products increased ninefold YoY due to increased inquiries from optical transceiver-related companies and accounted for over 70% of optical components orders. Smartphone-related (AI smartphone) orders fell 26% YoY to JPY 3.1bn; semiconductor-optics integration and electronic devices rose 192% to JPY 1.1bn; EV/connected car rose 34% to JPY 0.9bn.
quarterly_data.figure: optical components orders JPY 9.7bn (+249% YoY); optical communications orders ninefold YoY

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company guidance: FY12/2026 consolidated forecast maintained (assumptions JPY 148/USD, JPY 22/CNY) - net sales JPY 38.2bn (+13% YoY), operating income JPY 6.2bn (+86%), ordinary income JPY 7.4bn (+131%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 5.6bn (+89%). 3Q FY12/2026 orders anticipated at approximately JPY 10bn as optical communications is expected to keep performing well (the start of July has been strong). The FY12/2026 optical communications order forecast is raised to JPY 20bn from approximately JPY 5bn initially (more than five times), on strong demand from optical transceiver-related companies driven by U.S. hyperscalers' increased investment appetite.
quarterly_data.figure: FY12/2026 net sales JPY 38.2bn; operating income JPY 6.2bn; 3Q orders ~JPY 10bn; optical communications orders JPY 20bn (from ~JPY 5bn)

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company view: driven by expanding U.S. hyperscaler capex, the transition to 800G/1.6T optical transceivers is accelerating and is driving early demand for optical thin-film and functional-film equipment. Optorun maps its tools to AI optical interconnect processes: vapor deposition (OTFC / NBPF / SPOC) for AR/HR and WDM/TFF films on lasers, optical filters and optical modules; sputtering (HSP / OWLS / OCT) for metal electrodes, TCO and functional films on SiPh PICs, TFLN and optical engines; ALD for passivation / barrier films for SiPh and CPO reliability; etching for SiPh, glass and TFLN waveguides; GCIB (OGCT-8000) for bonding, packaging and optical alignment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q2 FY12/2026 results: sales rose 49% YoY to JPY 8.9bn and operating profit rose 64% to JPY 576mn (ordinary profit +16% to JPY 431mn). Company: equipment acceptance is generally proceeding as expected, but the higher-than-anticipated volume of shipments leaves a negative impact of several hundred million yen of internal profit on equipment not yet accepted; a JPY 200mn equity-method loss was recorded, mainly from Zhejiang Crystal-Run Opto-Electronics Technology (49% stake), which the company expects to turn profitable from the third quarter.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 sales JPY 8.9bn (+49% YoY); operating profit JPY 576mn (+64%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: utilization at the Shanghai plant, the company's main production facility, is rising; because order intake has exceeded projections, the company is expanding procurement of core components and strengthening customer support. Company-cited risk factors: an approximately 9-month lead time for film deposition equipment, rising costs due to shortages of key components, and yuan appreciation.

quarterly_data.quarter: Optorun press release: Consolidated Financial Results Briefing for FY12/2026 Q2 (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mid-term management goals ('Second Founding'): evolve from an optical film coating equipment maker into an optoelectronics convergence company adding a silicon photonics business. Targets: FY12/2026 group sales JPY 53.2bn (consolidated equipment sales JPY 38.2bn, products business (EMA) sales JPY 15.0bn, ordinary income JPY 7.4bn); FY12/2028 group sales JPY 66.0bn (equipment JPY 44.0bn, silicon photonics JPY 4.0bn, EMA JPY 18.0bn, ordinary income JPY 12.0bn); FY12/2030 group sales JPY 84.0bn (equipment JPY 48.0bn, silicon photonics JPY 16.0bn, EMA JPY 20.0bn, ordinary income JPY 17.0bn). New mid-term targets: net profit margin of 15% or more, ROE of 10% or more.
quarterly_data.figure: FY12/2030 group sales JPY 84.0bn incl. silicon photonics sales JPY 16.0bn; FY12/2028 silicon photonics JPY 4.0bn
